chapters.title: Signs of the Second Coming
chapters.synopsis: Leaving the temple, Jesus sits on the Mount of Olives and answers his disciples' questions about the temple's destruction and his coming. He foretells the tribulation of the Jews and Jerusalem's fall, then the signs that will come before the Son of Man returns in glory. Through the fig tree, the days of Noah, and the faithful and evil servants, he urges his elect to treasure up his word and watch.
